help.title: How to Play Werewolf AI
help.subtitle: Learn the rules and strategies for playing Werewolf with AI characters

overview.title: Game Overview
overview.description: Werewolf AI is a social deduction game where you play alongside intelligent AI characters. The game is divided into two teams: the Villagers and the Mafia (Werewolves). The Villagers must identify and eliminate all Mafia members, while the Mafia tries to eliminate Villagers without being discovered.
overview.villagerWin: Villagers win by eliminating all Mafia members
overview.mafiaWin: Mafia wins when they equal or outnumber the Villagers

villager.name: Villager
villager.description: Regular townspeople with no special abilities. They must use deduction and observation to identify the Mafia members during day discussions.

mafia.name: Mafia
mafia.description: Evil players who know each other's identities. They secretly eliminate one Villager each night and must blend in during day discussions to avoid detection.

seer.name: Seer
seer.description: A special Villager who can investigate one player each night to learn if they are Mafia or not. Must share information carefully to avoid becoming a target.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: A special Villager who can protect one player each night from Mafia elimination. Cannot protect the same player two nights in a row.

day.name: Day Phase
day.description: All players discuss and debate to identify suspicious behavior. The phase ends with a vote to eliminate a suspected Mafia member.
day.accusation: Players can accuse others of being Mafia
day.voting: All alive players vote to eliminate one player
day.elimination: The player with the most votes is eliminated

night.name: Night Phase
night.description: Special roles perform their actions in secret. The Mafia chooses a victim, while the Seer investigates and the Doctor protects.
night.mafia: Mafia members choose a Villager to eliminate
night.doctor: Doctor chooses one player to protect
night.reveal: Night results are revealed at dawn

ai.title: Playing with AI Characters
ai.description: Each AI character has a unique personality and playing style. They will engage in discussions, make accusations, and vote based on their observations and role.

features.title: AI Features
features.personality: Unique personalities with period-appropriate names and backgrounds
features.memory: Remember previous discussions and player actions
features.strategy: Strategic thinking based on their role and game state
features.deduction: Logical deduction to identify suspicious behavior
features.deception: Mafia AI will lie and create false alibis

tips.title: Tips for Playing with AI
tips.observe: Pay attention to AI voting patterns and accusations
tips.engage: Engage in discussions to gather information
tips.trust: Build trust with Villager AI to form alliances
tips.suspicious: Watch for inconsistencies in AI stories
